title: Broaden Q8_0 probe coverage with a default-off tensor name filter

motivation.current_probe_gap: The first Q8_0 probe only sampled the earliest fallback records, all from blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight.
motivation.why_this_matters: Before any output-writing Q8_0 path, op-level validation must cover at least up and down tensor roles and preferably nonzero layers.

implementation_boundary: Add an optional substring filter inside the existing Q8_0 probe.
If unset, preserve current probe behavior.
If set, skip tensors whose src0_name does not contain the substring before allocating CUDA buffers or reserving probe records.
Do not modify dst, routing, cache admission, direct pool, or accepted SOTA envs.
validation_plan: Run bounded probe for ffn_up_exps and ffn_down_exps under 16GB systemd cgroup.
Summarize records, max_abs, mean_abs, tensor names, exit status, and memory events.
If either probe fails, revert runtime source and keep only rejected documentation.
promotion_rule: This change cannot be promoted as SOTA; it only strengthens correctness evidence for a later output-writing Q8_0 path.
